title: Experienced Flutter Developer(West Bengal Candidates apply only)
description:
**Experienced Flutter Developer(West Bengal candidates apply only)**

**Company:** Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Overview:-

Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled and motivated **Flutter Developer** with **2–3 years of hands-on experience** in mobile application development. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of **Flutter and Dart** and experience in developing, testing, debugging, and deploying high-quality mobile applications.

Key Responsibilities:-

* Develop and maintain mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Build responsive and user-friendly applications for Android and iOS platforms.
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional mobile applications.
* Integrate **REST APIs, third-party APIs, and backend services**.
* Work with databases and cloud services such as **Firebase**.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance.
* Implement new features and improve existing application functionality.
* Perform application testing and resolve technical issues.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and project teams.
* Use **Git/version control** for code management.
* Prepare applications for testing and production deployment.
* Follow coding standards, best practices, and development guidelines.

Required Skills:-

* 2–3 years of professional experience in **Flutter Development**.
* Strong knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**.
* Good understanding of mobile application development.
* Experience with **REST APIs and JSON**.
* Knowledge of **Firebase** and push notifications.
* Understanding of state management such as **Provider, BLoC, or Riverpod**.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub or other version-control systems.
* Good debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of Android/iOS application deployment will be an advantage.

Education:-

* B.Tech/B.E./MCA/BCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science/IT is preferred.
* Relevant professional experience and strong technical skills will also be considered.
